theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
    classical
    intro ϑ hϑ_gt_0
    induction ϑ with
    | zero => contradiction
    | succ ϑ' ih =>
      cases ϑ' with
      | zero =>
        intro u hprob_gt
        have h₁ := multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation (F := F) u
        have h₂ := prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq (F := F) (P := fun r => Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u 0) (u 1) r, MC) ≤ e)
        simp_rw [h₁, h₂, Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hprob_gt
        have h₃ := hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) hprob_gt
        simp only [jointProximityNat₂] at h₃
        have h₄ : u = finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) := by funext i; cases i <;> rfl
        rw [h₄.symm] at h₃
        exact h₃
      | succ ϑ'' =>
        intro u hprob_gt
        set U₀ := (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ'' + 1) u).1
        set U₁ := (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ'' + 1) u).2
        set ϑ_pred := ϑ'' + 1
        set R_star_set := R_star_tensor MC (m := ϑ_pred) (e := e) (ε := ε) U₀ U₁
        have h_finsnoc_eq_r : ∀ (r : Fin (ϑ_pred + 1) → F), Fin.snoc (fun i ↦ r i.castSucc) (r (Fin.last ϑ_pred)) = r := by
          intro r; funext i
          by_cases h : i = Fin.last ϑ_pred
          · simp only [h, Fin.snoc_last]
          · have h_i_ne_last_val : i.val ≠ Fin.last ϑ_pred := by omega
            rw [Fin.val_last] at h_i_ne_last_val
            simp only [Fin.snoc, Fin.castSucc_castLT, cast_eq, dite_eq_ite, ite_eq_left_iff]
            omega
        let P : F → (Fin ϑ_pred → F) → Prop := fun r_last r_init => Δ₀(multilinearCombine u (Fin.snoc r_init r_last), MC) ≤ e
        have hP_split_r_last := prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun (ϑ := ϑ_pred) (F := F) (P := P)
        simp_rw [h_finsnoc_eq_r] at hP_split_r_last
        rw [hP_split_r_last] at hprob_gt
        have multilinearCombine_snoc_eq_multilinearCombine_affine (r_init : Fin ϑ_pred → F) (r_last : F) :
            multilinearCombine u (Fin.snoc r_init r_last) = multilinearCombine (affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r_last) r_init := by
          rw [multilinearCombine_recursive_form]
          simp only [Fin.snoc_last, Fin.init_snoc]
          rfl
        simp_rw [multilinearCombine_snoc_eq_multilinearCombine_affine] at hprob_gt
        have h_prob_Rstar_gt_eps_div_q : Pr_{ let r ← $ᵖ F }[ r ∈ R_star_set ] > (↑ε : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) := by
          exact prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) (ε := ε) (ϑ := ϑ_pred) (u := u) (e := e) hprob_gt
        have h_line_close_to_C_m : ∀ (r : R_star_set), jointProximityNat (u := affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r.val) (e := e) (C := MC) := by
          intro r_in_Rstar
          apply correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor (ih := fun u' => ih (by omega) u') u
        set m := 2 ^ ϑ_pred
        have h_m_ge_1 : m ≥ 1 := by exact Nat.one_le_two_pow ϑ_pred
        have h_prob_line_gt_eps_div_q :
            Pr_{ let r ← $ᵖ F }[Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u₀ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ ϑ_pred)) ι from U₀)) (u₁ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ ϑ_pred)) ι from U₁)) (r := r), ((MC ^⋈ (Fin (2 ^ ϑ_pred))))) ≤ e] > (↑ε : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) := by
          apply lt_of_le_of_lt' (Pr_le_Pr_of_implies (D := $ᵖ F) (g := fun r => Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u₀ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ ϑ_pred)) ι from U₀)) (u₁ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ ϑ_pred)) ι from U₁)) (r := r), ((MC ^⋈ (Fin (2 ^ ϑ_pred))))) ≤ e) (f := fun r => r ∈ R_star_set) (fun r hr => by
            specialize h_line_close_to_C_m ⟨r, hr⟩
            unfold jointProximityNat at h_line_close_to_C_m
            exact h_line_close_to_C_m)) h_prob_Rstar_gt_eps_div_q
          simp only
          omega
        have h_C_m_gap := h_interleaved_gaps m h_m_ge_1
        have h_final_gap : jointProximityNat₂ (MC ^⋈ (Fin (2 ^ ϑ_pred))) (⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ ϑ_pred)) ι from U₀)) (⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ ϑ_pred)) ι from U₁)) e := by
          apply h_C_m_gap (⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ ϑ_pred)) ι from U₀)) (⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ ϑ_pred)) ι from U₁)) h_prob_line_gt_eps_div_q
        exact CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA u e h_final_gap
